hooks.name: player_jump
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no such event; Bukkit's PlayerJumpEvent)

rust_summary: A guest jumped from the ground (`native_player_jump`).
doc_summary: A guest jumped: `native_player_jump(player, name)` is called after accepted movement made the server player jump from the ground, once the guest's movement simulation finished. The guest's state is swapped in. Bundles need "hooks": @API:player_jump@.
